FAQ

Questions before we automate?

Who is MB Automate for?

Service businesses, agencies, local companies, ecommerce brands, and operators who want to reduce manual work and respond to leads faster.

Do I need to know AI or coding?

No. We map the process, build the automation, connect your tools, test it, and show you how to use it.

What tools can you connect?

Common setups include websites, forms, Gmail, Google Sheets, Calendly, CRMs, Stripe, Slack, Notion, Airtable, Make, n8n, Zapier, and OpenAI.

How fast can we launch?

A focused MVP can usually be built in 3-7 days once the process and access are clear.
